sn35.233:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā ca Ānando āyasmā ca Kāmabhū Kosambiyaṃ viharanti Ghositārāme || || 2
sn35.233:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Kāmabhū sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Ānandena saddhim sammodi ||
sn35.233:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ katham sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Kāmabhū āyasmantam Ānandam etad avoca || ||
sn35.233:2.1: Kiṃ nu kho āvuso Ānanda cakkhuṃ rupānam saṃyojanaṃ rūpā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ || pa ||
sn35.233:2.2: jivhā rasānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ rasā jivhāya saṃyojanam || pa || ||
sn35.233:2.3: mano dhammānam saṃyojanaṃ dhammā manassa saṃyojananti || || 4
sn35.233:3.1: Na kho āvuso Kāmabhū cakkhu rūpānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ na rūpā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.233:3.2: yañca tattha tad ubhayam paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo || taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ || pa || ||
sn35.233:3.3: Na jivhā rasānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ na rasā jivhāya saṃyojanaṃ || ||
sn35.233:3.4: Na mano dhammānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ na dhammā manassa saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.233:3.5: yañca tattha tad ubhayaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo || taṃ tattha saṃyojanaṃ || || 5
sn35.233:4.1: Seyyathāpi āvuso kāḷo ca balivaddo odāto ca balivaddo ekena dāmena vā yottena vā saṃyuttā assu || ||
sn35.233:4.3: kāḷo balivaddo odātassa balivaddassa saṃyojanaṃ odāto balivaddo odātassa balivaddassa saṃyojananti || sammā nu kho so vadamāno vadeyyāti || ||
sn35.233:4.5: Na kho avuso kāḷo balivaddo odatassa balivaddassa saṃyojanaṃ na pi odāto balivaddo kāḷassa balivaddassa saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.233:4.6: yena ca kho te ekena dāmena vā yottena vā saṃyuttā || taṃ tattha saṃyojanam ||
sn35.233:4.7: Evam eva kho āvuso na cakkhu rupānaṃ saṃyojanaṃ || na rūpā cakkhussa saṃyojanaṃ ||
sn35.233:4.10: yañ ca tattha tad ubhayam paṭicca uppajjati chandarāgo || taṃ tattha saṃyojananti || || 1
